biography: Rodrigo Mange, a name whispered with both excitement and apprehension in Brazilian motorsport circles, hails from the sun-drenched favelas of Rio de Janeiro. His journey began not in a go-kart, but weaving through chaotic city streets on a battered scooter, honing reflexes that would later become his greatest asset. A local mechanic, recognizing Rodrigo’s innate talent, scraped together enough funds to enter him in a regional karting competition. It was there, amidst the roar of engines and the smell of burning rubber, that Rodrigo truly found his calling. His raw speed and fearless overtaking maneuvers caught the eye of Jarno Motors, who quickly signed him to their young driver program. While flashes of brilliance have punctuated his early career, consistency remains elusive, a frustrating paradox for a driver capable of such breathtaking moments. Currently, Rodrigo is striving to solidify his position within Jarno Motors, battling not only his competitors but also his own inner demons.
drivingStyle: Rodrigo's driving style is a high-risk, high-reward affair. He attacks corners with an almost reckless abandon, often pushing the limits of grip to extract every last tenth of a second. While undeniably thrilling to watch, this aggressive approach frequently leads to tire degradation and costly mistakes. In pressure situations, Rodrigo's composure can waver; he sometimes cracks under the weight, either overdriving the car or making uncharacteristic errors. However, when he's 'on,' his raw speed and audacious overtaking maneuvers are a sight to behold, a testament to his natural talent.

rivalries.reason: A long-standing rivalry from their karting days, fueled by a clash on the final lap of the Brazilian Karting Championship that cost Rodrigo the title.

quirks: Always wears the same faded Senna t-shirt under his race suit.

famousQuote: Speed is life. Everything before and after is just waiting.
careerHighlight: Winning the Brazilian Formula Regional Championship in 2022, a dominant display that showcased his potential and secured his seat with Jarno Motors.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final race of the 2023 season due to an unforced error, costing Jarno Motors a potential team championship victory.
